review_candidates.description: Job Summary We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Pre-Authorization Officer to manage insurance pre-authorization requests for medical services. The role involves verifying insurance eligibility, preparing and submitting authorization requests, following up with insurance companies, and coordinating with clinical and hospital teams to ensure timely processing and accurate documentation. Key Responsibilities Verify patient insurance eligibility, policy validity, benefits, and pre-authorization requirements. Review service requests and ensure all required documents are complete and accurate. Coordinate with clinical teams to obtain medical reports, treatment plans, investigation results, and clinical justifications. Submit authorization requests through insurance portals and hospital systems. Follow up on pending requests and respond promptly to insurance company queries. Record approval references, authorized services, validity dates, limits, and applicable conditions. Communicate approvals, partial approvals, rejections, and pending requirements to relevant hospital teams. Request authorization extensions or additional approvals when necessary. Coordinate reconsideration requests for rejected authorizations with supporting documentation. Escalate urgent cases according to established procedures. Maintain accurate authorization trackers and provide regular updates on pending cases. Ensure patient confidentiality and compliance with information security policies. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in a healthcare-related discipline or a relevant field. 2–4 years of experience in hospital pre-authorization, medical insurance approvals, or a related revenue cycle management role. Previous experience in the relevant healthcare insurance market. Experience coordinating with clinical, billing, and medical insurance teams. Good understanding of medical terminology, insurance benefits, and authorization workflows. Experience handling insurance company or third-party administrator (TPA) queries. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and relevant hospital systems. Practical experience using insurance portals. Good written and verbal English communication skills. Strong coordination, follow-up, and organizational skills. High attention to detail and the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
